//: Grafana dashboard for the QSH pipeline. docker-compose.yml has bind-mounted ../monitoring/grafana into the provisioning path since Round 1, but the directory did not exist, so Docker silently created a root-owned empty one and no dashboard was ever provisioned. Panels below read the metrics qsh.monitoring.exporter actually emits.
title: QSH — quantum-safe pipeline

panels.title: Stage latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: qsh_stage_latency_ms is a histogram; p95 shows which stage dominates a run.

panels.title: QBER
panels.description: Quantum bit error rate from the most recent QKD stage. The BB84 secure threshold is 11%; sustained values above it mean the key must be discarded.

panels.title: Benchmark latency by path (ms)
panels.description: MPC-FHE (classical CKKS + MPC) against QSMPC-FHE (QOTP + Clifford+T QCNN).
